'''April 2000 Seattle tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Seattle, Washington on 15 April 2000. It is known from Keith Watabayashi's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d532">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-16-seattle-washington-4-15-00d532/ seattle-washington-4-15-00], DeckTech (Keith "Gen" Watabayashi, 16 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-16-seattle-washington-4-15-00d532/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 15 April 2000
* '''Site:''' Seattle, Washington
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
